title.narrative: Continuation and expansion of psycho-social care to Ukrainian refugees in Eastern Slovakia and IDPs

description.narrative: During the design of this project, it was evident that tailored and context-specific psycho-social support for IDPs and refugees was the greatest unmet need. The approach taken has been to identify Ukrainian refugee women in Slovakia who are able to be employed to provide psycho-social care. Carefully selected and equipped with adequate training, these refugees are providing psycho-social assistance to children and adults visiting the various types of places set up for helping refugees and IDPs. There are three core components to this second phase project (building on Phase 1 which ran from May - August 2022): (1) Continued provision of psycho-social care by Ukrainian refugees in Slovakia, (2) Expanded provision of psycho-social care in Ukraine (Western Carpathia, Transcarpathia, and regions of Kharkiv, Dnipro, and Zaporizhzhia), and (3) Provision of technical training and psycho-social support to front-line psycho-social workers in Ukraine and Slovakia, many of whom have lived experience of the war.
